subject: [PATCH 10/46] mm/huge_memory: fix list corruption when deferred_split_scan() races with deferred_split_folio()

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner
reviews.summary: Provided a Reviewed-by tag and suggested looking into an alternative proposal that uses list_del_init_careful() instead.

reviews.author: Mani Tofigh
reviews.summary: Confirmed that the careful variant is fine without list_empty_careful() and praised David's version as a more complete fix.
reviews.raw_body:
On 10/27/26 11:15 AM, David Hildenbrand (Arm) wrote:
> While I have your attention: This variant works, a different proposal used
> 
> list_del_init_careful()
> 
> instead. However, that is documented to require list_empty_careful().
> 
> Do you think it's worth looking into?
> 
> 
> https://lore.kernel.org/all/20261026-thpsplit-careful-v1-1-d357d70fd6f4@columbia.edu/

In this case the careful variant is fine without
list_empty_careful() since it writes ->prev first
and then ->next with smp_store_release(), and
__list_lru_add() only writes to the entry after it
sees -> next == entry so it can't race with the ->prev
write anymore.

But your version also covers the PG_partially_mapped
race your comment mentions, which mine doesn't, so
it's the more complete fix anyway.

Thanks,
Mani

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand
reviews.summary: Responded to Mani's confirmation and thanked him for checking the patch.

2026-10-27.patch_summary: Fixes a list corruption issue in huge_memory when deferred_split_scan() races with deferred_split_folio().
